text:
maria_csm: Ok team — HelioLabs dedicated bring-up kickoff. Customer expects reserved quota ~120k tokens/min with peak concurrency ~140. Go-live target: next Wed 10:00 PT. Need: autoscale policy sanity check, load-test windows, warmup/priming plan, and rollback playbook. Dry-run = Mon 08:00 PT (smoke), Full load = Wed 08:00 PT (ramped to peak). @jia_devops can you run scripts? @omar_se can you confirm model variants and concurrency limits? @amanda_sre please own rollback/escalation. :rotating_light:
sarah_cs: copied. do we have client-side ramp profile/file? need steady + spike + long-tail phases.
maria_csm: yes — pasted sample ramp below (short). also attaching a k6 snippet for the long-tail load.
```javascript
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export let options = { stages: [ { duration: '5m', target: 50 }, { duration: '10m', target: 120 }, { duration: '5m', target: 10 } ] };
export default function () {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({model: 'redwood/gpt-small-v2', prompt: 'summarize: ...'}), { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer $TOKEN', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }});
  sleep(1);
}
```
maria_csm: high-level traffic templates: steady=60qps, peak burst=130-140qps for 6-8min, long tail=10-20qps for 30m. priming: 15-20min of targeted prompts to populate KV cache prior to ramp.
jia_devops: I can run both windows. plan to exec: `k6 run --vus 120 --duration 15m helio_profile.js` for Wed. will need endpoint + auth and confirmation of reserved pool. sharing run command:
```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=xxxx
k6 run --out json=results-dryrun.json helio_profile.js
```
omar_se: model variants: prod will use `redwood/gpt-small-v2` (higher perf). fallback = `redwood/gpt-small-quant` for cost tier. recommend pinning to `v2` during the full test. also set service env `MAX_IN_FLIGHT=150` and `TOKEN_LIMIT=2048` for test.
leo_prod: agree on warmup. I'll add a 20m warmup job that hits: `/v1/generate` with top-20 common prompts to populate KV and prefix cache. warmup snippet:
```bash
for p in prompts.txt; do
  curl -s -X POST $ENDPOINT -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d "{\"model\":\"redwood/gpt-small-v2\",\"prompt\":\"$p\"}" >/dev/null &
done
```
amanda_sre: I'll own post-test smoke and rollback. rollback trigger: p95 latency > 500ms for 5m OR error rate > 2% -> shift affected routes to shared pool + notify oncall. escalation list pinned in runbook. will prepare runbook checklist and handoff notes.
capacity-bot: Reservation engine: reserved pool check OK. Reserving 40 GPUs to HelioLabs for test windows. Reservation ID: RSRV-8871. Allocated capacity expires Wed 12:30 PT.
maria_csm: :thumbsup: nice. can everyone ack with ETA to prepare artifacts? also need enablement call 30m after dry-run to walk customer through findings.
sarah_cs: ack — I'll run enablement checklist and send calendar invite to HelioLabs ops.
jia_devops: ack — will post `results-dryrun.json` and perf summary here after the run.
omar_se: ack — I'll run model perf measurements and memory profiles.
leo_prod: ack — warmup logs posted to the same S3 path.
amanda_sre: ack — on-call handoff and rollback steps set.
jia_devops: Dry-run complete. initial run: peak qps 70 (we limited to 70), p95 320ms, overall error rate 1.6%. found ~5% errors in long-tail due to tokenization edge-case; patched tokenizer setting and re-ran quick replay -> errors down to 0.4%. uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-ops/heliolabs/dryrun-2412345678/ (results-dryrun.json, prom-summary.csv, warmup-log.txt). will schedule Wednesday full-run and post final config here.
